data.name: crawler-google-places
data.description: Extract data from thousands of Google Maps locations and businesses, including reviews, reviewer details, images, contact info, including full name, email, and job title, opening hours, prices & more. Export data, run via API, schedule and monitor runs, or integrate with other tools.
data.title: Google Maps Scraper
data.seoDescription: Extract data from any place on Google Maps. Get addresses, contact details, business leads with emails and job titles, reviews, prices, menus, coordinates, images, popular times, and more.

pricingInfos.reasonForChange: To make pricing transparent and predictable based on your actual usage. This change will also allow us to significantly speed up the Actor.

actor-start.eventDescription: Flat fee for starting an Actor run. More details.

place-scraped.eventDescription: Cost per place successfully scraped from Google Maps. More details.

filter-applied.eventDescription: Extra cost per place for each filter applied (e.g. category, title match, minimum stars, website availability, or skipping closed places). Final price = places scraped * filter price * number of filters. More details.

place-details-scraped.eventDescription: Flat cost per place to retrieve additional place details (e.g. table reservation data, web results, or max questions). The price remains the same no matter how many details you select. More details.

image-scraped.eventDescription: Extra cost per image retrieved from a place, including author details. More details.

data.readmeSummary:
## Google Maps Scraper

Google Maps Scraper extracts structured business data from Google Maps by automating the Maps UI: it runs searches, scrolls result lists, enqueues place detail pages and scrapes detailed place profiles into rich structured records. Outputs include business names, addresses, precise coordinates, phone numbers, websites, company contact data scraped from websites (including legal Impressum details when present), enriched lead records (full names, job titles, LinkedIn profiles, work emails when available), social media profiles with follower/verification metadata, ratings and review data (counts, per-review text and metadata, review distributions and detailed ratings), images and image metadata, opening hours, popular times histograms and live occupancy, menus, price bracket, reservation and booking links, hotel- and restaurant-specific metadata, lists of businesses inside indoor venues, additional semantic tags and attributes, and optional AI-powered competitor-analysis reports and interactive map visualizations. Technical capabilities include flexible search strategies (keyword and category searches, direct place URLs/IDs, and geospatial search areas defined with GeoJSON geometries such as polygons, multipolygons, or point+radius), full place-detail scraping, optional company-contact and social-profile enrichment, optional email verification, and review extraction at scale with per-review or per-place output formats.

## Use cases

- Generate qualified leads by extracting business contact details, websites, emails, and phone numbers
- Track competitors across regions to monitor presence, ratings, and review trends
- Perform market analysis to assess saturation, identify service gaps, and benchmark local businesses by size, rating, and visibility
- Support partnerships by discovering top-rated or high-volume locations for outreach
- Automate research workflows to replace manual Google Maps searches and keep datasets up to date
- Extract and analyze Google reviews including per-review text, ratings, timestamps, and reviewer metadata
- Enrich place records with company contacts, Impressum data, social media profiles, and verified email checks
- Produce AI-powered competitor analysis reports and interactive map visualizations for comparative benchmarking
